title: Stacking Cards
description: Cards that land on top of each other as you scroll, each sticking a little lower than the last.
usage: The landing-page stack, without a library: each card is position sticky with a slightly deeper top offset, so scrolling deals them onto a pile. Pure CSS — the demo lives in a boxed scroller, but the same rules run a full page section. Four cards is a story; eight is a filing cabinet.
a11y: Sticky positioning only changes layout: reading order is document order, and every card is fully reachable by scrolling or by keyboard. Nothing is hidden, shrunk away, or conveyed only by the stacking.
